verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe end-to-end fine-tuning (LoRA or full) on supported base models via console/API/CLI, followed by deployment of the fine-tuned model to a dedicated inference endpoint on the same platform, covering the full lifecycle from data upload to hosted inference. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of a fine-tune-then-serve workflow succeeding in practice, and detail on which base models specifically support fine-tuning.
